name: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
opening_hours: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM (April to September), 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM (October to March)
rules: Follow designated winding path through all phases
Do not climb or deface recycled ceramic sculptures
visual_features: surreal multi-acre open-air sculpture garden composed of recycled broken ceramics, bangles, and industrial scrap forming whimsical courtyards and waterfalls
description: The Rock Garden of Chandigarh is a sculpture garden in Chandigarh, India. It is also known as Nek Chand Saini's Rock Garden of Nathupur  after its founder Nek Chand Saini, a government official who started building the garden secretly in his spare time in 1957. It has spread over an area of 40 acres (16 ha), and is completely built from industrial, home waste, and discarded items.
